title: Render paymaster semantics: carry raw paymasterAndData, show sponsor identity and fee-token pull
threat: The device signs keccak/sha256(paymasterAndData) but never sees the bytes: it cannot show WHO sponsors gas or that an ERC-20 fee-token paymaster will debit USDC up to a max cost. A compromised companion can route through a hostile paymaster; the user sees only '! PAYMASTER SET / may debit tokens'.
proposal: Pre-launch wire change (input format only; on-chain output unchanged): replace the 32-byte `paymaster_and_data_hash` input with `[pm_len(2)][paymasterAndData ≤ 256 B]`, compute the hash in S-world, and render: paymaster address with NAMES_DB-verified name ('+' sentinel), mode decode for pinned providers (Pimlico ERC20PaymasterV06: fee token + exchange-rate/max-cost words → 'Gas paid in USDC, max 1.23'), 'Sponsored (no debit)' for verifying-paymaster shapes, and a loud '! UNKNOWN PAYMASTER' danger page otherwise. Cross-check: an inner `approve(spender==paymaster)` in the same UserOp renders the spender as 'PAYMASTER' with the amount, refusing unlimited unless the policy (CS-03) allows.
rationale: No shipping hardware wallet decodes 4337 UserOps at all, so this is pure 'beyond'; but today pq1's own guarantee has a hole the docs do not state. v0.6 folds keccak(paymasterAndData) into userOpHash, so what the device renders is exactly what the C10 signature authorises — the device becomes the source of truth on who pays. The roadmap already identifies this and the unlimited-approve(paymaster) hazard.
repo_evidence: aa/src/userop.rs:56,678,717,827 (only a 32-byte hash of paymasterAndData enters the sphincs digest; firmware never sees bytes)
secure/src/tx/display/value_page.rs:544-551 (page text '! PAYMASTER SET / Gas sponsored / may debit tokens' — no address, no token)
gh issue search 'paymaster' returns only #328 (CFI parity of the existing page), no decoding issue
vendor_precedent: none (Ledger/Trezor have no UserOp path; Ethereum Magicians eth_signUserOperation thread confirms no standard)
risks: CLAUDE.md labels the sign input 'frozen'; the freeze rationale (on-chain verifier) applies to the OUTPUT, so this needs an explicit owner decision + companion + e2e fixture update. Paymaster mode decoding is provider-specific and churns (Alchemy v0.6 sunset) — pin by (chain, address, codehash-era) in dbgen like ERC-7730, refuse unknown.
